name: Average Daily Mood Score
description: Your average overall mood level over a selected period (e.g., this week vs. last week).
ai_summary_potential: Highlight periods of positive/negative mood trends; compare to previous periods.
actionable_tip_potential: Suggest reflection during low mood, reinforce positive habits during high mood.

name: Most Frequent Emotions
description: The top emotions you've logged most often (from initial check-ins and CBT entries).
display_type_suggestion: Bar Chart (frequency count), Word Cloud (larger for more frequent)
ai_summary_potential: Identify your most prevalent emotional challenges; categorize positive vs. negative emotions.
actionable_tip_potential: Suggest coping strategies for specific frequently occurring negative emotions.

name: Common Cognitive Distortions
description: The most frequent unhelpful thinking styles identified in your 'Automatic Thoughts'.
ai_summary_potential: Highlight recurring thought traps; explain common distortions in simple terms.
actionable_tip_potential: Offer strategies specific to challenging identified distortions (e.g., 'Evidence Against' prompts).

name: Reframe Effectiveness Score
description: The average percentage decrease in negative emotion intensity *after* completing a CBT thought record.
derivation_source: CBT Journaling (Initial vs. Outcome Emotion Intensities)
ai_summary_potential: Quantify the success of using CBT techniques; reinforce positive impact.
actionable_tip_potential: Encourage continued use of CBT; provide tips for deeper re-framing.

name: Journaling Streak
description: Your current consecutive daily journaling streak.
display_type_suggestion: Large Number with Flame Icon, Progress Bar
ai_summary_potential: Celebrate consistency; provide encouragement for maintaining habit.
actionable_tip_potential: Offer gentle reminders if streak is at risk; suggest benefits of consistent journaling.

name: Common Situation Triggers
description: Recurring themes or types of situations that precede your journal entries or specific emotional responses.
display_type_suggestion: Word Cloud, Tag List, Bar Chart (frequency)
ai_summary_potential: Identify external factors influencing mood/thoughts; link to specific emotions.
actionable_tip_potential: Suggest strategies for managing specific trigger situations (e.g., 'prepare for X event').
